items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ralph Gleason came to that concert and really gave us a bad review.

ctx.x: The Geary Cellar was under the Geary Theater. NBC was around the block, in the same block, their main studios, and Jimmy was broadcasting every night. I can’t remember meeting at the Geary Cellar, but apparently he came in. Then when we played the Marines Memorial, he came to that concert. Ralph Gleason came to that concert and really gave us a bad review.
Ralph Gleason gave you a bad review.
